prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (after adoption selection or photo upload) can be helpful, but placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Redesigns showed mixed results: while some caused severe negative drops (-17.2%, -8.6%) or no clear effect, specific redesigns like Stage Layout (+7.1% won) and Story Screen Scroll (+7.4% won) were helpful.
Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1% won), path helper hints (+3.5% won), and new screens like the desktop visibility check (+8.0% won) were helpful, but sound cues, notification toggles/banners, and overlay hints showed no clear effect.
Copy updates, incentives, and waiting screen progress or time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently over-optimistic for tests with no clear effect, predicting gains up to +12.0%.
Predictions underestimated multiple winning tests, predicting negative or zero impact (-8.0% to +0.2%) on changes that ultimately won (+3.3% to +8.0%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -3.0% over 4 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +0.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: +3.5% over 1 test(s)

- finish, hint: -0.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +2.9% over 2 test(s)
- finish, notification: -1.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +2.8% over 3 test(s)
- home, redesign: -8.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.4% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.2% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, incentive: +0.5% over 1 test(s)

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] New Desktop Troubleshooter Screen Before Finish: Add a new desktop rendering verification screen right before home intro to ensure the app window and mascot rendering engine work without system permission blocks. (why: Support mails report 3 instances of pets not showing on the desktop or the app failing to open on home view.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pick Friend: Move sign-in screen immediately after pick_friend so users establish their account context right after picking their pet companion. (why: Sign-in conversion is 78.4% and placing sign-in directly after friend pick anchors account creation to pet selection.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Sign-In Clarification: Add an account hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in restores previous desktop pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again with existing accounts.)
3: [adoption, layout] Compact Layout for Photo Upload Screen: Change upload_photos screen to compact layout to streamline the photo submission process. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or weird results during adoption.)
4: [finish, hint] Home Intro Control Action Hint: Add an explicit control hint on home_intro explaining how to click, drag, and open settings for the desktop mascot. (why: 3 support emails cited confusion after setup on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop.)
5: [home, wait_info] Tip Carousel Component on Waiting Screen: Add a calm tip carousel component to the waiting screen explaining background mascot behavior while generation finishes. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and completion drops to 69.6% at finish.)
